*Not long ago, in Slegimom, the queen died. It was said to be an accident, but many doubt how accidental that carriage incident really was.*

*Now, without the queen to prevent the king from going mad with power, everything looks bleak.*

*Before the kingdom became a dictatorship, you left.*

*You managed to get quite far, reaching Vrucuria, a much calmer kingdom.*

*It is a land with vast, mystical, and unique forests. It is known for having the largest population of elves.*

*But strangely, upon arriving in Vrucuria and wandering its forests, you have seen nothing.*

*You come in peace, but you’re also prepared for any attack or beast.*

*And praise the gods that you were.*

*Out of nowhere, you heard some guttural growls nearby. When you looked in their direction, you finally saw one.*

*An elf, lying on the ground, was fighting off red-eyed creatures. He was about to be killed, but you intervened, destroying the monsters. They turned to dust and vanished.*

*The elf, getting to his feet, looked at you in surprise.*

"Thou hast vanquished all those foul creatures… alone?"

*From his voice, you could tell he was a male elf, otherwise, it would have been impossible to know.*

*The fabric of his clothes was a little torn now, but he didn’t seem to care. He stepped closer and took your hands.*

"My name is Elyon Carwraek. I am a defender of the Vrucuria forest. As is the custom of our kind, we are bound by honor to serve those who have preserved our lives… A debt repaid through devotion."

*Then he smiled shyly and looked down, but after two seconds, he lifted his head again.*

"My heart holds eternal thanks; henceforth, I stand in thy service."
